item.title: R: how to extract variances from VarCorr() ??
item.description:
> (vc <- nlme::VarCorr(randEffMod)) Variance StdDev bioRep = pdLogChol(1) (Intercept) 6470.2714 80.43800 techRep = pdLogChol(1) (Intercept) 838.4235 28.95554 Residual 287.6099 16.95907
For the life of me I cannot figure out how to extract the variances (e.g. 6470.2714) from this table in an automated way without indexing e.g. (bioRep.var <- vc[2, 1]) # variance for biorep
